newsitem.title: USA: Employee Solutions posts results, stock rises.
newsitem.headline: Employee Solutions posts results, stock rises.

text.p: Employee Solutions Inc., whose stock plunged last week on fears of disappointing earnings, said Monday its fourth-quarter profits were hurt by growing competition and weakness in workers' compensation and benefits markets.

"While we are obviously pleased to announce substantially increased revenues and earnings for the year, we are disappointed with the fourth-quarter operating results, even though earnings exceeded fourth quarter 1995," said Chairman Marvin Brody.

Employee Solutions, which provides payroll, human resources and benefits outsourcing services, said profits rose to $2.3 million, or 7 cents a share, in the quarter ended Dec. 31 from $1.6 million, or 5 cents a share, in the year-ago period.
Revenues more than doubled to $148.8 million from $73.1 million.
The company said results were also affected by its workers' compensation reserves, which were increased to $5.2 million as of Dec. 31.

Employee Solutions saw its stock lose half its value on Thursday after the company delayed release of fourth-quarter results. On Friday, the stock fell another 60 percent after the Phoenix-based company confirmed it was expecting weak earnings.
Employee Solutions rose $2 to $8.25 on Nasdaq, where it was one of the most active issues in afternoon trading.
